label: Diagram 11.7
caption: Diagram 11.7 Permitted unprotected areas in small residential buildings
description:
The image is a diagram titled "Diagram 11.7 Permitted unprotected areas in small residential buildings". The text "See para 11.18" appears at the top left.

On the left is a plan view of a building shown in outline. Part of its perimeter, along the bottom edge and a notch, is drawn in green. A green double-headed arrow spanning the width of the building is labelled "24m max." A second green double-headed arrow, labelled "a", runs from the green side of the building down to a dashed line labelled "Relevant boundary".

On the right is a table with two columns, headed "Minimum distance (a) between side of building and relevant boundary (m)" and "Maximum total area of unprotected areas (m²)". The rows read: 1, 5.6; 2, 12; 3, 18; 4, 24; 5, 30; 6, No limit. The label "a" in the table corresponds to the distance arrow in the plan.
